product_metadata.title: GMOEGEFT Christmas Gnome Plush Singing and Dancing Santa, Nordic Tomte Holiday Home Decorations, Red
features: LUCKY GNOME - According to Scandinavian folklore, gnomes usually hide from humans and use magic. They are reputed to safeguard the farmer and his family against any misfortune.

SINGING & DANCING GNOME - Turn on the button and beat on the body, the gnome can sing and dance until the classic Christmas song ends. Adorably and absolutely delightful, this plush gnome provides easy holiday cheer. Three 1.5V AA batteries are required. (Batteries are not included in the package.)

GREAT MATERIAL - The gnome is made of premium polyester and plastic, dressed in a classic knit coat and wore a hat with a small bell. The beards are long and they are made of gray faux fur. Its high cap includes wire, which is bendable.
SUITABLE SIZE - This gnome measures approximately 15.7 inches in height, and 7.5 inches in width. (Box packing, package includes 1 gnome.)

PERFECT CHRISTMAS GIFT - Gnome generally serves as a good gift, as it is not only a doll but also a talisman for the house. Giving this entertaining Christmas gnome to your family or friends and get a smile and laugh out of everybody.
